note: The control commands of POST /api/robot/{id}/command that this app sends, with the limits the server enforces. HYDRA-UMC-IOS-CONTROL keeps an identical copy; a change starts here, in both. tools/gen_command_contract.py writes app/src/main/java/com/hydraumc/control/network/RobotCommandContract.kt from this file and the validation fails when they differ.

deadManJog.note: Continuous jog held by a dead-man: jogStart, a heartbeat every heartbeatMs while the control is held, jogStop on release. The server stops the axis when no heartbeat arrives for serverTimeoutMs; the app also stops by itself after maxMissedHeartbeats failed heartbeats, after maxHoldMs, or when the link health blocks it. PENDING in HYDRA-UMC-SERVER: the three commands.

linkHealth.note: Round-trip time of the link to the server, measured with a small request; it blocks the continuous jog when the link is bad. PENDING in HYDRA-UMC-SERVER: a dedicated ping field.

pairing.note: Pairing by QR code or link made by the admin page of the server: hydra-umc://pair?host=..&port=..&fp=<sha256 hex of the TLS certificate>&name=.. . The app shows what it read and asks before it keeps anything. PENDING in HYDRA-UMC-SERVER: the admin page that draws the code.

watchAlerts.note: Alerts the phone pushes to the watch (path /hydra-umc/alert/v1 of the watch protocol), rationed so a burst never floods the wrist.

presenceRelay.note: The phone passes the presence heartbeat of the watch to the server, which decides what a lost heartbeat means. PENDING in HYDRA-UMC-SERVER: the endpoint.

voiceConfirmRelay.note: The phone passes the two-step confirmation of a spoken order from the watch to the server; it needs a session and the reservation of the robot. PENDING in HYDRA-UMC-SERVER: the endpoint.

works.note: Work files (trajectories) the server lists in <folder>/index.json and serves as a JSON list of points; the `trajectory` command loads one into the robot.
